skyplume.blurb: A naturally shed highland plume, gathered after a won encounter or gentle grooming.
skyplume.description: A naturally shed highland plume, gathered after a won encounter or gentle grooming. Bind it with Gale Fiber into soft camp bedding.

saddle_frame.blurb: A rootstone-braced skeleton. Wants woven padding and a creature's back, in that order.

insulated_boots.description: A found pair with dry insulating layers under a waxed canvas shell. While worn, it cuts lightning strike damage by 15% and Static duration to 85%; all four insulated pieces turn a strike into stagger only.

sparkfur.description: Naturally shed, static-bright fur collected after a won encounter or gentle grooming. It pads insulated gear.

hide_helm.name: Padded Helm
hide_helm.blurb: Woven padding over the crown. Softens a bad fall.
hide_helm.description: Stiffened woven padding cushions accidental knocks and hard landings. The trainer never fights.

hide_vest.name: Padded Vest
hide_vest.blurb: Layered woven padding over the chest and back.
hide_vest.description: Two woven layers cushion the ribs and shoulders against hard landings.

hide_leggings.name: Padded Leggings
hide_leggings.blurb: Tough cloth padding over the thighs and knees.
hide_leggings.description: Woven pads cover the thighs and knees, cushioning hard landings on uneven ground.

hide_boots.name: Padded Boots
hide_boots.blurb: Thick woven soles cushion the ankles.
hide_boots.description: Tough woven uppers and cushioned soles soften awkward landings.

saddle_frame.name: Saddle Frame
saddle_frame.blurb: A rootstone-braced frame, ready for woven straps and a creature mount.

insulated_boots.description: Dry insulating layers under tough cloth cut lightning strike damage by 15% and Static duration to 85%; all four insulated pieces turn a strike into stagger only.

stoneguard_brew.description: A gritty brew helps the creature brace for a hard fight. Fur and feathers sit heavier on the drinker for a minute and a half.

elixir_guard.description: A grey tonic permanently strengthens the creature’s protective outer layers. Its benefit persists through rest.
